hook.en: Engineers building one road over another must know the least gap between them. For two skew lines this least gap is measured along the line perpendicular to both.
hook.kn: ಒಂದು ರಸ್ತೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಇನ್ನೊಂದನ್ನು ಕಟ್ಟುವ ಎಂಜಿನಿಯರ್‌ಗಳಿಗೆ ಅವುಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಅಂತರ ತಿಳಿದಿರಬೇಕು. ಓರೆ ರೇಖೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಈ ಅಂತರವನ್ನು ಎರಡಕ್ಕೂ ಲಂಬವಾದ ರೇಖೆಯ ಉದ್ದಕ್ಕೆ ಅಳೆಯುತ್ತೇವೆ.

objectives.en: Recognise skew, parallel and intersecting lines
Find the shortest distance between skew lines
Find the distance between parallel lines

narration.en: Engineers building one road over another must know the least gap between them. For two skew lines this least gap is measured along the line perpendicular to both.
narration.kn: ಒಂದು ರಸ್ತೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಇನ್ನೊಂದನ್ನು ಕಟ್ಟುವ ಎಂಜಿನಿಯರ್‌ಗಳಿಗೆ ಅವುಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಅಂತರ ತಿಳಿದಿರಬೇಕು. ಓರೆ ರೇಖೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಈ ಅಂತರವನ್ನು ಎರಡಕ್ಕೂ ಲಂಬವಾದ ರೇಖೆಯ ಉದ್ದಕ್ಕೆ ಅಳೆಯುತ್ತೇವೆ.

body.en: Skew lines are neither parallel nor intersecting; they do not lie in one plane. The shortest distance is the length of the common perpendicular. For $\vec r = \vec a_1 + \lambda\vec b_1$ and $\vec r = \vec a_2 + \mu\vec b_2$, it is the projection of $\vec a_2 - \vec a_1$ on $\vec b_1\times\vec b_2$.
body.kn: ಓರೆ ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಸಮಾಂತರವೂ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಛೇದಿಸುವುದೂ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ದೂರ = ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಲಂಬದ ಉದ್ದ = (a₂ − a₁) ನ b₁ × b₂ ಮೇಲಿನ ಪ್ರಕ್ಷೇಪ.

points.en: Shortest distance = 0 ⇔ the lines intersect (they are coplanar)
Direction of the common perpendicular: b₁⃗ × b₂⃗

narration.en: Skew lines neither meet nor run parallel. Their shortest distance is along the common perpendicular, whose direction is b one cross b two. So we project the vector joining the two given points onto b one cross b two.
narration.kn: ಓರೆ ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಸಮಾಂತರವೂ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಛೇದಿಸುವುದೂ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ದೂರ = ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಲಂಬದ ಉದ್ದ = (a₂ − a₁) ನ b₁ × b₂ ಮೇಲಿನ ಪ್ರಕ್ಷೇಪ.

blocks.formula: d = \left|\frac{(\vec b_1\times\vec b_2)\cdot(\vec a_2 - \vec a_1)}{|\vec b_1\times\vec b_2|}\right|

body.en: If the lines are parallel, $\vec b_1 = \vec b_2 = \vec b$, so $\vec b_1\times\vec b_2 = \vec 0$ and the skew-line formula fails. Then the distance is $\frac{|\vec b\times(\vec a_2 - \vec a_1)|}{|\vec b|}$.
body.kn: ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಸಮಾಂತರವಾದರೆ b₁ × b₂ = 0, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಬೇರೆ ಸೂತ್ರ: d = |b × (a₂ − a₁)| / |b|.

narration.en: For parallel lines, b one cross b two is zero, so we need a different formula: the magnitude of b cross a two minus a one, divided by the magnitude of b.
narration.kn: ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಸಮಾಂತರವಾದರೆ b₁ × b₂ = 0, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಬೇರೆ ಸೂತ್ರ: d = |b × (a₂ − a₁)| / |b|.

problem.en: Find the shortest distance between r⃗ = î + 2ĵ + k̂ + λ(î − ĵ + k̂) and r⃗ = 2î − ĵ − k̂ + μ(2î + ĵ + 2k̂).

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find the shortest distance between r⃗ = î + 2ĵ + k̂ + λ(î − ĵ + k̂) and r⃗ = 2î − ĵ − k̂ + μ(2î + ĵ + 2k̂).

problem.en: Find the distance between the parallel lines r⃗ = î + 2ĵ − 4k̂ + λ(2î + 3ĵ + 6k̂) and r⃗ = 3î + 3ĵ − 5k̂ + μ(2î + 3ĵ + 6k̂).

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find the distance between the parallel lines r⃗ = î + 2ĵ − 4k̂ + λ(2î + 3ĵ + 6k̂) and r⃗ = 3î + 3ĵ − 5k̂ + μ(2î + 3ĵ + 6k̂).

body.en: For skew lines the numerator (b₁⃗ × b₂⃗)·(a₂⃗ − a₁⃗) is a 3 × 3 determinant: rows a₂ − a₁, b₁ and b₂. So d = |determinant| / |b₁⃗ × b₂⃗|. If the determinant is 0, the lines intersect.

narration.en: Box over cross. For skew lines the numerator (b₁⃗ × b₂⃗)·(a₂⃗ − a₁⃗) is a 3 × 3 determinant: rows a₂ − a₁, b₁ and b₂. So d = |determinant| / |b₁⃗ × b₂⃗|. If the determinant is 0, the lines intersect.

narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ತಂಡದೊಳಗೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ಒಂದೇ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒಪ್ಪಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

narration.en: Now two questions in the pattern of KCET, COMEDK and JEE. Read every option before you choose.

points.en: Skew lines are neither parallel nor intersecting.
points.kn: ಓರೆ ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಸಮಾಂತರವೂ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಛೇದಿಸುವುದೂ ಇಲ್ಲ.

points.en: Skew lines: d = |(b₁⃗ × b₂⃗)·(a₂⃗ − a₁⃗)| / |b₁⃗ × b₂⃗|.
points.kn: ಓರೆ ರೇಖೆಗಳು: d = |(b₁ × b₂)·(a₂ − a₁)| / |b₁ × b₂|.

points.en: Shortest distance zero means the lines intersect.

narration.en: Recap. Skew lines are neither parallel nor intersecting. Skew lines: d = |(b₁⃗ × b₂⃗)·(a₂⃗ − a₁⃗)| / |b₁⃗ × b₂⃗|. Parallel lines: d = |b⃗ × (a₂⃗ − a₁⃗)| / |b⃗|. Shortest distance zero means the lines intersect.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಓರೆ ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಸಮಾಂತರವೂ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಛೇದಿಸುವುದೂ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಓರೆ ರೇಖೆಗಳು: d = |(b₁ × b₂)·(a₂ − a₁)| / |b₁ × b₂|. ಸಮಾಂತರ ರೇಖೆಗಳು: d = |b × (a₂ − a₁)| / |b|. ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ದೂರ ಶೂನ್ಯವಾದರೆ ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಛೇದಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.
